title: AI-Powered Redaction
description: Powered by latest Claude and GPT models for unmatched accuracy. Automatically detect and redact {PII|Personally Identifiable Information}, {PHI|Protected Health Information}, and 50+ sensitive entity types across all file formats.

title: Security & Compliance
description: {AES-256|Advanced Encryption Standard with 256-bit keys} encryption, zero-trust architecture, and private processing. {GDPR|General Data Protection Regulation} compliant with SOC 2, ISO 27001, {HIPAA|Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act}, and CCPA readiness.

title: Multimodal Format Support
description: Redact sensitive data across documents (PDF, DOCX), images (PNG, JPG, TIFF), data files (CSV, JSON, XLSX), audio (MP3, WAV), and video (MP4). Consistent accuracy across all formats.

title: Flexible Redaction Strategies
description: Choose from blackout, masking, tokenization, or synthetic data replacement. Define custom redaction rules per entity type and apply consistently across your organization.

title: Developer APIs
description: {RESTful APIs|Representational State Transfer - web service architecture} with comprehensive documentation, TypeScript and Python {SDKs|Software Development Kits}. Integrate redaction into your workflows in minutes.

title: Audit Trails
description: Complete audit logs for every redaction operation. Track what was redacted, when, and by whom. Export compliance reports for {GDPR|General Data Protection Regulation}, HIPAA, and CCPA audits.
